test_title: RRB NTPC UG 2025: शताब्दी शनिवार - Mega Live Test
subject: general
question: The theater club meets at the school auditorium every 28 days, and the poetry club meets at the same place every 20 days. If both groups are at the auditorium today. In how many days will they next have to share the auditorium?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The time when both clubs will next meet together is the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of their individual meeting intervals.

Required days = LCM of 28 and 20.

Since 28 = 4 × 7 and 20 = 4 × 5, their LCM is 4 × 5 × 7 = 140.

**∴ The correct answer is 140 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Meeting interval of the theater club = 28 days

Meeting interval of the poetry club = 20 days

**Concept Used:**

To find the next common meeting day for events that repeat at different intervals, we calculate the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of those intervals.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Prime factorization of 28 = 2 × 2 × 7 = 2² × 7

⇒ Prime factorization of 20 = 2 × 2 × 5 = 2² × 5

⇒ The LCM is determined by multiplying the highest powers of all prime factors present.

⇒ LCM(28, 20) = 2² × 5 × 7

⇒ LCM(28, 20) = 4 × 5 × 7

⇒ LCM(28, 20) = 140

**∴ The correct answer is 140 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM (Least Common Multiple)

The smallest positive integer that is exactly divisible by every member of a set of numbers. It is highly useful in synchronisation and repeating event problems.

HCF (Highest Common Factor)

The largest positive integer that divides two or more numbers without leaving a remainder. It is used to divide different quantities into equal, maximum possible groupings.

LCM and HCF Relationship

For any two given numbers a and b, the product of the numbers is equal to the product of their HCF and LCM: a × b = LCM(a, b) × HCF(a, b).
